description: This file implements the initialization, creation, and removal functions for a COSA backend manager object, along with sys event handling functions. It includes module setup, external API references, and internal object management for a specific component related to XDNS within a larger system.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerCreate
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new COSA backend manager object, setting function pointers and object ID.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager object, creates the XDNS object, and initializes web configuration framework.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes the backend manager object, including the XDNS object, and frees memory.

methods.name: openCommonSyseventConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the sys event service if not already connected.

methods.name: commonSyseventSet
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the sys event system.

methods.name: commonSyseventGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key from the sys event system.
